errors.evidence: The description fails to mention the break in the x-axis, which jumps from 80k to 420k. This is a significant structural feature of the plot.
The tick marks on the x-axis are at intervals of 20k up to 80k, but then at intervals of 10k from 420k to 440k. The description incorrectly states the interval is consistently 20k.
The description fails to mention the break in the y-axis, which jumps from 0.4 to 0.75. This is a significant structural feature of the plot.
The tick marks on the y-axis are at intervals of 0.2 only in the lower part of the axis (0.0, 0.2, 0.4). There is a break, and the upper ticks are at 0.75 and 0.85, not following a 0.2 interval.

errors.text_span: All lines start near a training loss of 0.85 at step 0k
errors.evidence: The plot shows that all lines start at a training loss at or slightly below 0.80, not near 0.85.

At step 20k, the lines have a wide spread of loss values, from approximately 0.15 for the lowest line (brown) to 0.3 for the highest line (green). Stating they all reach 0.2 is a significant over-generalization and factually incorrect for most lines.

By step 440k, the loss values have stabilized in a range much lower than described. The lowest loss is around 0.02-0.03 (brown line) and the highest is just under 0.1 (green line). The stated range of 0.05 to 0.15 is incorrect.
